newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary bourse seen positive, but rally slowing.
newsitem.headline: Hungary bourse seen positive, but rally slowing.

text.p: The Hungarian share market is expected to slow down on Tuesday following Monday's rally which brought the BUX index to a new record high, traders said.

"I expect some consolidation," said Gabor Borda of Concorde Securities. "I don't think that Hungarian investors could continue to trigger substantial further rallies," he said, adding that the Dow's drop on Monday also pointed to a calmer market.
Traders said foreign investors were not particularly active on the market, while domestic investors were seen buying heavily.

"The pace of the rise will certainly slow down amid a positive market sentiment," said Gyorgy Czipo of ING Barings. "Domestic investors keep on buying but the gains rise in certain stocks may falter as some closing prices were extremely high on Monday," he said.
"Foreign investors are much more cautious than domestic clients."
On Monday the BUX index closed at a new record high of 5,902.04 points.
